patch_description: The current program uses a single greedy ordering (by req_rate/slo) plus local search. The key parameters are the model ordering key and the local search neighborhood. I propose running the greedy + local-search pipeline with multiple ordering keys — req_rate/slo, model_size, density req_rate/(slo*model_size), and the composite (weight, size) — then returning the placement with the lowest resulting max KVPR. This is essentially free computationally and directly lowers the max KVPR objective, as different orderings favor different test instances.
